title: artemisia maritima proles gallica
intro: Artemisia maritima proles gallica, commonly known as Sea Wormwood, is a subspecies of the Sea Wormwood plant, which is a shrubby perennial herb belonging to the daisy family. The plant has been traditionally used to treat various health issues, including digestive problems, fever, and respiratory infections, due to its health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Artemisia maritima proles gallica include antiseptic, anti-inflammatory, and expectorant properties, which help to soothe and calm the body. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
